  PROBLEM: The test still asserts the old `CLAUDE_POOL_REASON: ${{ steps.claude_pool.outputs.reason || '' }}` literal, but orchestrate_poll.yml now uses the capacity-wait fallback expression.
  WHY: The assertion raises AssertionError in the static-checks job of run 38565112995. Severity is the HIGHEST across reviewers, with BLOCKER mapped to critical.
- tests/test_smoke_alert_silencing_contract.py:73-87 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: EXPECTED_STEP_DECLARATIONS pins 7 ALERT_MSG_LEVEL declarations each for review_autofix.yml and orchestrate_poll.yml, but they now have 9 and 8.
  WHY: `test_step_level_alert_level_declarations_are_pinned` compares exact lists and fails in tests-hooks-and-orchestrator in run 38565112995.
- tests/test_orchestrator_judges_claude_engine.py:945,953 and tests/test_orchestrate_poll_workflow_contract.py:368-369 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: These tests pin the old `if` conditions and the old CLAUDE_POOL_REASON value, which the PR rewrote in orchestrate_poll.yml.
  WHY: The exact-equality asserts fail when these CI-run modules are reached. Severity is the HIGHEST across reviewers (BLOCKER mapped to critical).
- scripts/provider_outage.py:398-399,972-996,1001 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: A failed `remove_label` in `_resume_wait_pr` (including a 404 on an already-absent label) returns "failed" without recording the dispatch as done, so later passes re-dispatch the review and the tracker never closes.
  WHY: The same claude_capacity marker keeps making `resume_decision` return resume, which causes duplicate review dispatches and a tracker wedged open. Severity is MAJOR, mapped to high.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:16510,16561-16610,20026,20220,21170,28749 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: Stall recovery checks only `ai:merge-queued` on the linked PR and never `ai:claude-capacity-wait`, so a capacity-paused review is redispatched repeatedly.
  WHY: Each cycle spends stall-recovery budget and can escalate an issue that is only waiting.
- scripts/claude_pool_health_alert.sh:111-113 and scripts/provider_outage.py:1078-1080 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The items file is written before the resume loop, so the alert step still sees the pre-resume count and sends "pool exhausted: N waiting" after a full recovery.
  WHY: The message contradicts the "capacity back" alert on every recovery tick. Impact is low because it is DEBUG level.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:"Resume Claude capacity waits" | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The "capacity back" notice is sent at WARNING level.
  WHY: agents.md reserves WARNING for events that need human action, and no one needs to act on this notice.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:247 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The `find_tracking` gate accepts any OWNER, MEMBER, or COLLABORATOR author association instead of verifying the GH_PAT login that provider_outage.py:475-485 checks.
  WHY: A collaborator can forge a tracker that forces `all_gated` for poller Claude roles. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 reviewed the same line and rated it NIT with confidence 2, so it did not report it.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: At every §2-table call site (except review/autofix), treat exit 80 as a wait and export CLAUDE_CAPACITY_WAIT_ITEM_KIND/ITEM_NUMBER/STAGE/SOURCE_COMMENT into each workflow's ai_engine_fallback_report.sh step.
  expected_change_site: check_failure_triage.yml (scripts/check_failure_triage.sh), issue_pr_status.yml (scripts/activation_verify.sh), workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml (scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh), unblock_judge.yml
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: Only 9 workflows reference ai_engine_fallback_report.sh and none of these is among them, check_failure_triage.sh:1491-1497, activation_verify.sh:386-389, workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:1664-1668 and unblock_judge.sh:1756-1760 skip without recording a wait, so one-shot events are lost. Severity MAJOR.

  expected_change_site: scripts/validation_discovery_bootstrap.py `discover_manifest_via_codex` and .github/workflows/validation-refresh.yml
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: validation_discovery_bootstrap.py:399-431 and 459-485 treat exit 80 as `codex_rc_nonzero(rc=80)`, retry, and end in VALIDATION_DISCOVERY_FAILED, and validation-refresh.yml only adds the env default and has no wait reporter. Severity is NIT from anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and MAJOR from the others (highest: MAJOR).
- requirement: Add the Phase 2 (and Phase 3/4) tests listed in the plan.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_codex_thread_reuse_core.py, tests/test_unblock_judge.py, tests/test_orchestrator_judges_claude_engine.py, tests/test_review_pool_reviewer.py, tests/test_claude_pool_health_alert.py, tests/test_orchestrate_poll_workflow_contract.py
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The plan-named modules are not extended in the PR, tests/test_claude_capacity_wait_call_sites.py mostly checks source-text needles, and nothing exercises the waiting section in claude_pool_health_alert.sh or `next_usable_at` in claude_engine.py. Severity MAJOR.
- requirement: On exit 80, set `CLAUDE_CAPACITY_WAIT=true` and exit the step successfully, and record the wait for automatic resumption.
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml (four Claude call sites and the wait-reporting path)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: Each exit-80 branch (including lines 521-527) emits an error and exits 80 without setting the wait flag, and there is no ai_engine_fallback_report.sh step. Severity MAJOR.
- requirement: Build Phase 3 of the capacity-wait plan, including validation self-heal exiting 80 like discover and diagnose.
  expected_change_site: scripts/self_heal_validation.sh and scripts/validate_process.sh
  confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The reviewer concluded that this appears addressed (self_heal_validation.sh:460-468, validate_process.sh:995-999, validate.yml:1242-1255), so the gap is closed. It is flagged as a NIT for review only.
- requirement: Tests that pin exact YAML expressions or step counts must be updated when the workflow changes those expressions or adds steps.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_security_audit_workflow_contract.py:3161, tests/test_smoke_alert_silencing_contract.py:73-87, tests/test_orchestrator_judges_claude_engine.py:945,953, tests/test_orchestrate_poll_workflow_contract.py:369
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The listed pins are stale against orchestrate_poll.yml and review_autofix.yml, which duplicates the BLOCKER findings above. Severity BLOCKER.
